title: Cursed Fate: Tooth Manipulation
description: my cursed fate addon mod, adds Tooth Manipulation and Soul eayer
body:
Adds tooth Manipulation Technique

Teeth Cannon
Chant: Launch yourself back, good for movement.
Flow: Increases the amount of projectiles and the speed of the projectiles.
Teething: uses a stronger projectile.

Teeth Burst
Biting Armor: changes the angle of the attack.
Chant: Summons teeth chunks in the ground.
Flow: Increases the amount of projectiles and the speed of the projectiles.
Teething: uses a stronger projectile.

Biting Armor
Chant: Deals more damage.
Flow: Lasts Longer.
Teething: Summons Teeth chunks in the ground.

Teething
Allows the user to use their Technique to the fullest

Roundsaw Jaw
Flow: Increases the duration of the attack and Bleeding lasts longer and deals more damage.
Teething: Increases the size of the attack.

Teethstorm
Flow: Increases the duration of the attack.
Teething§r: Increases the size of the attack.

Adds Soul Eater Technique

Stalk: A stalked target is more vulnerable to attacks. Debuffs anything in a 5 block radius with darkness and stalked. Chant: Doubles the radius of the attack. Flow: Doubles the duration of the effect. Unmask: Switches to a constant aoe ability that'll last for a while.

Massacre (hold): Strike the target with multiple slashes. Flow: Increases the duration of the attack. Unmask: Increases the size of the attack.

Fallow Will: Opens a menu with 3 abilities. Using any of these will make you lose 25% of your own hp. Pruning: Regain 50% of your cursed energy. Grim Harvest: Deal 25% of the targets hp. Grafting: Heal 25% of the targets hp.

Soul Drain/Soul Feast (hold): slowly eat the targets soul Flow:Increases the duration of the attack. Unmask:Switchs to a aoe attack, flow incrases the size of this.

Unmask: Allows the user to use their Technique to the fullest.

Soul Garden: (Domain) Effect 1: Effect all targets in your domain with darkness and stalked, simple domain can't block this. Effect 2: eat the souls of anything in a 5 block radius.

1 New enemy
toothling  teratoma trapdoor snow spider glow butterfly  

2 New enchantments
soul hit (ingores 30% of armor)
lightning (summons lightning on hit)

2 New weapon
tooth blade
large cleaver

1 New Biome Gum infection

3 Useful Blocks 
Idle Transfiguration table (switches food types)
Exp to Curse Table (transfers exp into cursed mastery
Sukuna's Finger (makes more cursed spirits spawn)

this mod is based off look outside(W Game)
